mechanism_narrative: A low current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the cost of capital for corporations and leading to higher equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A current unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand across multiple sectors, which typically results in lower corporate profits and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from their previous month's level, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO above 110), the S&P 500 tends to experience positive returns over the next 20 trading days as strong manufacturing output supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 110, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A current CPIAUCSL value above 200.0 signals elevated inflation, which typically prompts the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in the real economy, which typically results in lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline from their previous quarter's level, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high current level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above the 75th percentile of its historical distribution, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A current industrial production index (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
